title: ios-acceptance-run
responsibility: Owns the ios-acceptance-run build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: pause.milliseconds
inputs.description: Timer delay passed to setTimeout before the promise resolves. Runtime timer precision and scheduling can delay completion.

inputs.name: control.run
inputs.description: The TEST ONLY Acceptance context for this request, including record and page instances, simulator UDID, fixture control origin, project id and name, and output path. The control origin must resolve to this machine.

inputs.name: control.path
inputs.description: Path concatenated directly to controlOrigin for the fixture request. Exactly /status selects GET; every other path selects POST.

inputs.name: control.body
inputs.description: Optional object JSON-encoded as the request body, with an application/json content-type header. Its fields are not validated by this function.

inputs.name: restart.run
inputs.description: The TEST ONLY Acceptance context supplying the page to reset and simulator UDID to relaunch. Its fixture control origin is not used by this operation.

inputs.name: restart.fixture
inputs.description: Whether to include the loopback fixture argument in the simulator launch. It defaults to true; false omits that argument.

inputs.name: shot.run
inputs.description: The TEST ONLY Acceptance context supplying the simulator UDID and screenshot output directory. The output directory is combined with the requested screenshot name.

inputs.name: shot.name
inputs.description: Name interpolated with a .png suffix and resolved against run.output after a 900 millisecond pause. The name is not sanitized.

inputs.name: openDesign.run
inputs.description: The TEST ONLY Acceptance context supplying the page and synthetic project name used by this flow. The operation also opens the fixture page through its card and waits for an image with nonzero naturalWidth.

outputs.name: computerName
outputs.description: Fixture computer name constant used to identify the computer in the acceptance fixture. Its exact value is Harness fixture computer.

outputs.name: panelText
outputs.description: Fixture panel script text exposed for the acceptance fixture. Its exact value is return panel();.

outputs.name: footerText
outputs.description: Fixture footer script text exposed for the acceptance fixture. Its exact value is return footer();.

outputs.name: pause
outputs.description: A function that resolves after scheduling a setTimeout for the supplied milliseconds. Timer scheduling is subject to runtime timing, and the function resolves without a value.

outputs.name: control
outputs.description: Resolves with the response JSON parsed from the fixture control endpoint and cast to T, without runtime shape validation. T defaults to FixtureView, whose fields are state, locked, requests, and devices.

outputs.name: offered
outputs.description: Resolves with the one-time offer returned by the fixture pairing endpoint. Before returning, it hides the offer code and QR scan text from run-record writes.

outputs.name: restart
outputs.description: Resolves after run.page.reset() completes and launch is invoked with the selected fixture and scan arguments. It does not wait for the relaunched app to become ready.

outputs.name: scanPressed
outputs.description: Resolves with the string returned by evaluating the scan action on the simulator page. It fills the optional phone name first, then tries Scan QR code or Scan again.

outputs.name: shot
outputs.description: Resolves without a value after pausing 900 milliseconds and asking the simulator screenshot helper to save a PNG at the resolved output path. The screenshot content is not returned.

outputs.name: openDesign
outputs.description: Resolves with loaded after opening the named project, confirming its title, opening the fixture page through its card, and waiting for an image with nonzero naturalWidth. The returned value is the readiness marker, not the image.

errors.name: Unsafe fixture origin or refused fixture command
errors.description: Thrown when the fixture control origin is not on this machine or the fixture responds with a non-OK status. The response status is included in the refusal error message.
